answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 65955 Country: India Title: Is lipstick of Indian or Western company halal? Question: Is lipstick of Indian or Western company halal? Answer ID: 65955 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 684/573/D=09/1437) If any haram or impure substance like the blood or fat of pig or dead is mixed in the lipstick then it is haram and unlawful to apply it. We are not aware of the ingredients of Indian or Western lipsticks. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
